published_final_diagnosis.label: Primary abdominal ectopic pregnancy with bleeding left upper abdominal implantation

source_treatment.description: Urgent diagnostic laparoscopy and excision of ectopic lesion with partial omentectomy

source_disposition.outcome: Discharged postoperative day 5; hCG normalized within one month.

key_guideline_decisions.note: See docs/guideline_sources.yaml; applicability and alternative care require clinician review.

distractors: Pain is in left upper abdomen and adnexa appear normal; early episode was labelled gastroenteritis.
critical_safety_points: Pregnancy test is essential in reproductive-age patient with abdominal pain.
No intrauterine pregnancy with hCG around 10,130 IU/L requires urgent ectopic pregnancy evaluation.
Hemorrhage and vascular implantation favor surgical planning with bleeding preparedness.
source_uncertainties: Unspecified dose, timing or normal findings were not inferred.
Published management is descriptive and requires separate normative review.
